it.txt: Presidente da Câmara Municipal, assumiu a prefeitura de forma interina em 21/07/2026, depois que a Justiça Eleitoral afastou o prefeito Manoel Natalino e o vice Zé Américo Filho, que tiveram os mandatos cassados em abril de 2026. Na eleição suplementar de 25/10/2026, foram eleitos Max Luz (SOLIDARIEDADE), prefeito, e Dominguim do Peixe (MDB), vice; eles tomam posse depois da diplomação pela Justiça Eleitoral.
it.txt_en: As president of the City Council, she became acting mayor on July 21, 2026, after the Electoral Courts removed Mayor Manoel Natalino and Vice Mayor Zé Américo Filho, whose terms were revoked in April 2026. In the special election held on October 25, 2026, Max Luz (SOLIDARIEDADE) was elected mayor and Dominguim do Peixe (MDB) vice mayor; they take office after being certified by the Electoral Courts.
